Hero_Desc_Aurora: Aurora, an Elemental from Glacia, longs to make friends. She can read emotions by observing a person's aura. Despite her kind heart, her nature makes her easy to misunderstand, causing unintended trouble wherever she goes.
Album_Hobby_Aurora: Gazing blankly at the night sky
Album_Wish_Aurora: To make a friend she can open her heart to
Album_Aurora1: Aurora is an Aurora Elemental who once lived among the frozen hills of Glacia. She can read the emotions of others by observing the colors of the auras rising from their bodies.
Album_Aurora2: Aurora can unleash powerful plasma flames, but she does not seem to enjoy using this ability. Before coming to Elias, she apparently caused a major accident with it in Glacia.
Album_Aurora3: Having lived in Glacia, Aurora seems unfamiliar with Elias's bright sunshine. At first she happily called it warm, but before long, she quietly moved away as though it had become too hot.
Album_Aurora4: Aurora works hard to remember the traits and preferences of everyone she meets in Elias. It is her own awkward effort to make even a few more friends.
Album_Aurora5: Unlike tranquil Glacia, the constant bustle of Elias sometimes makes Aurora dizzy. When a flood of auras carrying countless emotions reaches her all at once, she appears to become tired.
Album_Aurora6: Aurora says she liked gazing up at the sky when she lived alone in Glacia. The night sky embroidered with starlight was beautiful, but it seems even that could not entirely fill her loneliness.
Album_Aurora7: When speaking with someone, Aurora reads their aura and does everything she can to match their mood. But perhaps she also needs to relax and reveal her own true feelings sometimes.
LoveHero_Aurora: Your warm aura, Master... The same light must surely be blossoming from me as well.
LoveHeroCancel_Aurora: D-Did I make another mistake? Uuuh...
Food_ChefNote_Aurora_Hate1: She forces a smile and says it is delicious, but she appears to be making herself eat it. I should not serve it to her again.
Food_ChefNote_Aurora_Hate2: She frowned after one bite. Its peculiar fishy taste seems to remind her of seaside pirates.
Food_ChefNote_Aurora_Like1: She seems to enjoy the refreshing lemon flavor and says it would taste wonderful with ice from Glacia.
Food_ChefNote_Aurora_Like10: She said eating it made her feel capable of unleashing immensely powerful plasma. I asked her to try it outside, since that sounded dangerous.
Food_ChefNote_Aurora_Like2: The smell of gunpowder seemed unfamiliar to her, but she ate happily and praised the exceptional sweetness.
Food_ChefNote_Aurora_Like3: She loved it the moment she tasted the warm broth, saying she had longed for hot food like this while living alone in Glacia.
Food_ChefNote_Aurora_Like4: She was fascinated, saying there were many similar trees in Glacia's forests. She seems to like the sweet flavor as well.
Food_ChefNote_Aurora_Like5: She says her aura sight seems clearer after eating it. Does the tart flavor improve concentration?
Food_ChefNote_Aurora_Like6: After tasting it, she tried to pack up the rest for Velvet. I promised to prepare some separately and told her to eat as much as she liked.
Food_ChefNote_Aurora_Like7: She is chewing with a completely relaxed expression. The combination of sweet chocolate and nuts seems to suit her.
Food_ChefNote_Aurora_Like8: Aurora looked exhausted from her work in the banquet hall, so I gave her one. She happily said it woke her right up.
Food_ChefNote_Aurora_Like9: The colorful candies amused her because they looked just like a collection of multicolored auras.

LoveLetter_Aurora:
Hello, Master. This is Aurora.

Have you been well? I am doing well in the Witch Kingdom. At first, I sometimes sensed auras that were wary of a stranger, but as we spent time together and their light gradually softened, I was able to relax as well. I owe the life I have now to you and the Apostles of the Order. It may be belated, but I wanted to write and express my gratitude!

If you ever wish to share the thoughts hidden deep in your heart, please come to me at any time.
I will warmly support you from beside you, so that a positive aura may blossom in your heart!
LoveCall_Aurora:
Ahem... Master, can you hear me clearly?
I simply... thought of you, so I decided to call. Hehe...

Actually, there was a time when I secretly studied your interests because I wanted to become closer to you...
This is your first time hearing about it? Naturally. I kept it completely hidden.
Even so, my eyes were always on you, Master.
I quietly observed, trying to learn what you liked and disliked...

Because you always spoke to me kindly and became someone I could rely on...
I have been able to live more comfortably in this vibrant world. Thank you, always, Master.
But that does not mean I intend to stop learning about you...!
May I remain beside you and watch over you for a long, long time?
I want to share deeper thoughts with you, Master, whose aura is like warm yellow light. Then, I will visit you soon...!
Affinity_Aurora_EP01_001: I wonder whether pretending not to see someone's emotions can sometimes be an act of kindness.
Affinity_Aurora_EP01_002: That depends upon your own judgment.
Affinity_Aurora_EP01_003: You are right. I must think further about how I can live harmoniously with everyone while possessing the ability to see their auras.
Affinity_Aurora_EP01_004: But you want to face everyone's heart directly, do you not?
Affinity_Aurora_EP01_005: ...I do. Pretending not to see another's emotions may be considerate, but I still want to approach them and speak about the light those emotions emit.
Affinity_Aurora_EP01_006: You cannot unsee what you have already seen. Simply accept it for what it is.
Affinity_Aurora_EP01_007: But... it concerns me. When someone's aura is dark, I feel as though my own aura darkens with it.
Affinity_Aurora_EP02_003: Lady Mago and I fed her animal friends. The way they ate while radiating bright auras was exceedingly adorable. Hehe.
Affinity_Aurora_EP02_004: You did not start another fire, did you?
Affinity_Aurora_EP02_005: N-No! I have resolved to avoid using my plasma flame in the forest whenever possible...!
Affinity_Aurora_EP02_006: It seems you have grown close to Mago. That is good to see.
Affinity_Aurora_EP02_007: I am pleased as well. At first, I mistook Lady Mago for someone frightening, but the more we speak, the more I sense the warmth of her heart.
Affinity_Aurora_EP03_001: What color aura do you think suits me, Master?
Affinity_Aurora_EP03_003: Um... Hmm... Could you choose once more?
Affinity_Aurora_EP03_005: B-Blue... Do I look somewhat sad...?
Affinity_Aurora_EP03_006: I think a bright yellow suits you!
Affinity_Aurora_EP03_007: Hehe, truly? Thanks to those words, a bright yellow aura may be rising from me at this very moment.
Affinity_Aurora_EP04_001: A resident I passed recently had an aura that wavered the moment they saw me. What could have happened?
Affinity_Aurora_EP04_002: Perhaps they were curious about you, or wanted to become friends.
Affinity_Aurora_EP04_003: Could that be it? Hehe, what a relief. Next time, I will speak first!
Affinity_Aurora_EP04_004: Did you have something on your face?
Affinity_Aurora_EP04_005: N-No! I always check carefully before going out... Ah! Could it have been crumbs from the fried sweet potato I bought after work at the banquet hall...?!
Affinity_Aurora_EP04_006: You are simply being self-conscious~ Do not worry about it.
Affinity_Aurora_EP04_007: S-Self-conscious... Perhaps you are right. Understood. I will not dwell upon it further...
Affinity_Aurora_EP05_001: Is observing a friend's aura wrong?
Affinity_Aurora_EP05_002: It might make them somewhat uncomfortable.
Affinity_Aurora_EP05_003: Yes... They may feel as though their innermost thoughts have been exposed. I will be more careful from now on.
Affinity_Aurora_EP05_004: Perhaps it is fine as long as you do not stare too openly.
Affinity_Aurora_EP05_005: Hmm. But secretly watching them would also feel somewhat...
Affinity_Aurora_EP05_006: You look because you care for your friends. Do not worry.
Affinity_Aurora_EP05_007: You are right. I want to work harder so everyone's aura can be filled with a positive light!
Affinity_Aurora_EP06_001: Hehe, the food here is truly delicious.
Affinity_Aurora_EP06_002: Is the food in Glacia not delicious?
Affinity_Aurora_EP06_003: O-Oh, no! That is not true! Glacia has many delicious foods, such as smoked ice treats and thin-ice noodles!
Affinity_Aurora_EP06_004: Tell me if there is anything else you wish to eat. I will make anything for you.
Affinity_Aurora_EP06_005: Thank you, Master...! I-I feel as though a yellow aura might rise from me without my even realizing it...
Affinity_Aurora_EP06_007: Hehe. Your green aura, so full of confidence, is wonderful to behold, Master.
Affinity_Aurora_EP07_002: Really? That is good. Have you made some friends?
Affinity_Aurora_EP07_003: Yes! Not yet enough to boast about, but every one of them is a precious friend!
Affinity_Aurora_EP07_004: You may not know that yet...
Affinity_Aurora_EP07_005: H-Hmm? Master? Your aura suddenly turned blue... Did you recall an unpleasant memory...?
Affinity_Aurora_EP07_006: Do the Witches take good care of you?
Affinity_Aurora_EP07_007: Yes. Some may scold me occasionally, but they are helping me adjust well.
Affinity_Aurora_EP08_001: Could my plasma flame someday help someone?
Affinity_Aurora_EP08_002: The kitchen happens to lack sufficient heat. Would you come and try?
Affinity_Aurora_EP08_003: Th-The kitchen? I cannot! I have burned the food far more than once!
Affinity_Aurora_EP08_004: Enough practice will make it possible. I will help you too.
Affinity_Aurora_EP08_005: Master...! Thank you. With your help, I feel certain I can succeed!
Affinity_Aurora_EP08_006: Is your flame not far too dangerous?
Affinity_Aurora_EP08_007: ...Perhaps it is. I should continue being careful and avoid using this power whenever possible.
Affinity_Aurora_EP09_001: Allow me to read your fortune, Master!
Affinity_Aurora_EP09_002: No. You will only dress it up with flattering words.
Affinity_Aurora_EP09_003: N-No...! I may exaggerate on rare occasions... but if you listen just once, even expecting to be deceived, it will surely be a worthwhile experience!
Affinity_Aurora_EP09_004: I am curious, but you will not charge me, will you?
Affinity_Aurora_EP09_005: Of course not! Consider it repayment for the delicious food you have prepared for me!
Affinity_Aurora_EP09_006: Oh, that sounds entertaining. Would you read it for me?
Affinity_Aurora_EP09_007: Yes! Of course! Let me see... Ah, an auspicious sign! From this day onward, every dish you prepare... will be supremely delicious! Hehe.
Affinity_Aurora_EP10_001: Working in the banquet hall has helped me understand at least a little of your hardship, Master.
Affinity_Aurora_EP10_002: You have it harder, living so far from home. Come here to rest often.
Affinity_Aurora_EP10_003: Thank you for understanding, Master! Th-Then... I will return. Often...
Affinity_Aurora_EP10_004: Are you adjusting to the work?
Affinity_Aurora_EP10_005: Yes! It can be difficult at times, but Lady Picora helps me well, and speaking with the Witches is enjoyable, so I am working hard.
Affinity_Aurora_EP10_006: You still do not understand the pain of cooking without rest...
Affinity_Aurora_EP10_007: Y-Your aura suddenly became dark?! I-It must indeed be difficult to care for every Apostle. I will come and help you often!
Affinity_Aurora_EP11_001: Hmm... Today feels like a day for making a new friend.
Affinity_Aurora_EP11_002: What sort of day is that?
Affinity_Aurora_EP11_003: A day when I do not want to remain still... when I wish to change something, perhaps...?
Affinity_Aurora_EP11_004: Have there been days when you did not?
Affinity_Aurora_EP11_005: ...O-Of course I always want to make new friends...!! Ugh...
Affinity_Aurora_EP11_007: Y-You mean it? How will you help me?! I am ready!
Affinity_Aurora_EP12_001: Listening to the stories of others is... hehe, far more fascinating than I expected.
Affinity_Aurora_EP12_002: Would you like to hear my story too?
Affinity_Aurora_EP12_003: Yes, I am curious...! I want to know as much about you as possible, Master!
Affinity_Aurora_EP12_004: You seem deeply interested in the other Apostles, Aurora.
Affinity_Aurora_EP12_005: I am. I know the joy of being together with others.
Affinity_Aurora_EP12_006: Whose story was the most fascinating?
Affinity_Aurora_EP12_007: Th-That is a secret! If I preserve their confidence, more people will feel comfortable opening their hearts to me.
Affinity_Aurora_EP13_001: I met a Beastfolk whom I would like to befriend.
Affinity_Aurora_EP13_002: A Beastfolk... Spending time with them certainly can be entertaining.
Affinity_Aurora_EP13_003: The Beastfolk seem to possess many fascinating stories.
Affinity_Aurora_EP13_004: It is not one of those Feedistance members, is it?
Affinity_Aurora_EP13_005: Feedistance? Was that the name...? Hmm... The name alone sounds extraordinary.
Affinity_Aurora_EP13_006: Did you visit the Beastfolk Forest?
Affinity_Aurora_EP13_007: No. It was a Beastfolk I happened to meet at the Order. She was remarkably lively and energetic...
Affinity_Aurora_EP14_001: Master, would you accompany me on a picnic? The weather is exceptionally pleasant today.
Affinity_Aurora_EP14_002: Certainly! Shall we visit the plaza where many Apostles gather?
Affinity_Aurora_EP14_003: I do not know whether one can picnic in the plaza, but I would like that!
Affinity_Aurora_EP14_004: Good. We can spread a blanket somewhere quiet and enjoy some snacks.
Affinity_Aurora_EP14_005: Hehe. Merely imagining it lifts my spirits. I will prepare some excellent snacks!
Affinity_Aurora_EP14_006: I heard it will rain this afternoon.
Affinity_Aurora_EP14_007: Ah... Hmm... Is that so...? What a shame...
Affinity_Aurora_EP15_001: Master, when there is an Apostle you wish to befriend, how do you usually approach them? Could you teach me?
Affinity_Aurora_EP15_002: Learning about their interests is one good method.
Affinity_Aurora_EP15_003: I see...! Then I should observe them more carefully to discover their interests!
Affinity_Aurora_EP15_004: You can also wait until they speak to you.
Affinity_Aurora_EP15_005: Ugh... What if I wait for them to approach, only for them to walk far away...?
Affinity_Aurora_EP15_006: I believe I was the one who spoke to you first...
Affinity_Aurora_EP15_007: Speaking first is extremely difficult... You are remarkable, Master!
Affinity_Aurora_EP16_001: It certainly is hot here. Could this weather be why everyone struggles to remain calm?
Affinity_Aurora_EP16_002: Who in the world did you meet...?
Affinity_Aurora_EP16_003: A Dragon carrying a greatsword. There was something extraordinary in her gaze...
Affinity_Aurora_EP16_004: Are the residents of Glacia generally calm?
Affinity_Aurora_EP16_005: Hmm... Now that I consider it, not all of them are. My conclusion was too hasty.
Affinity_Aurora_EP16_006: Is it hot? I cannot really tell.
Affinity_Aurora_EP16_007: Ugh... I do not want to leave this cool banquet hall...
Affinity_Aurora_EP17_001: Do you have many friends, Master?
Affinity_Aurora_EP17_002: W-Why are you curious about that?
Affinity_Aurora_EP17_003: Hmm? Why are you so flustered?
Affinity_Aurora_EP17_004: May I count the Apostles as friends?
Affinity_Aurora_EP17_005: Of course! Anyone with whom you share your heart and maintain a close bond is a friend!
Affinity_Aurora_EP17_006: Ahem. Well~ I suppose I do.
Affinity_Aurora_EP17_007: Oh! As expected of you, Master...! You are wonderfully sociable!
Affinity_Aurora_EP18_001: Please be understanding when Lady Velvet causes a little trouble. She is not wicked at heart.
Affinity_Aurora_EP18_002: Hmm. For your sake, Aurora, I will overlook it once.
Affinity_Aurora_EP18_003: Ah... Thank you. You truly are a generous Master...!
Affinity_Aurora_EP18_004: You are the truly kind one, Aurora, for recognizing Velvet's good qualities.
Affinity_Aurora_EP18_006: A good heart cannot excuse every problem she causes.
Affinity_Aurora_EP19_001: I carefully observed the auras of the Apostles who visited the banquet hall today. Yellow light rippled around them.
Affinity_Aurora_EP19_003: Green light sometimes mingled with it, perhaps because they felt secure here.
Affinity_Aurora_EP19_004: How do you feel today, Aurora?
Affinity_Aurora_EP19_005: I am happy to be with you, Master. The food is delicious too.
Affinity_Aurora_EP19_006: Haha! That proves how delicious my cooking is!
Affinity_Aurora_EP19_007: Oh... Such confidence...! I wish to learn from you!
Affinity_Aurora_EP20_001: Several days ago, I discovered a light resembling my plasma flame.
Affinity_Aurora_EP20_002: Did you see it aboard a Monatium sightseeing bus...?
Affinity_Aurora_EP20_003: No. Has such a light ever flashed inside the bus?
Affinity_Aurora_EP20_004: It must have shone remarkably brightly.
Affinity_Aurora_EP20_005: Yes. Reflections upon a glass vase rippled beautifully. I would like to show them to you too, Master.
Affinity_Aurora_EP20_006: Did you discover it at an underground idol venue...?
Affinity_Aurora_EP20_007: Does such a place exist? Surely many Apostles gather there?
